title: Possible hard-coded credential in configuration
message: Value is never copied to the report; check location and rotate if real.

title: Client certificate received in an HTTP header (mTLS terminated by an intermediary)
message: The application reads the client certificate from a header: an intermediary (proxy, API gateway, load balancer) terminates mutual TLS in front of it. Who requires it and which consumers use it is not in the code.
